esp32_gpio_touch_read.tooltip: Touch pins only; no pinMode needed. Values fall on ESP32 and rise on S2/S3/P4.

esp32_gpio_touch_threshold.tooltip: Absolute raw threshold; comparison direction follows the chip. Measure idle and touched values first.

esp32_gpio_touch_calibrate.tooltip: Run in setup with the electrode untouched. Samples are clamped to 1–64.

esp32_gpio_touch_pressed.tooltip: Calibrate first. Change is clamped to 1–90%; smaller is more sensitive. Release uses half the activation change for hysteresis.

esp32_gpio_touch_baseline.tooltip: Returns 0 before calibration or after failure. Recalibrate after electrode or timing changes.

esp32_gpio_touch_cycles.message0: Touch legacy measurement cycles %1 sleep cycles %2
esp32_gpio_touch_cycles.tooltip: Legacy driver only: ESP-IDF below 5.5 and touch version up to 2. Use timing in microseconds on the new driver.

esp32_gpio_touch_timing.message0: Touch new measurement time %1 us interval %2 us
esp32_gpio_touch_timing.tooltip: New driver only: ESP-IDF 5.5+ or touch version 3. Set before the first touch read or interrupt registration.

esp32_gpio_touch_interrupt.message0: Listen to touch pin %1 hardware threshold %2 on event %3
esp32_gpio_touch_interrupt.tooltip: Actions run in loop; events may coalesce and include release. ESP32 uses an absolute threshold; S2/S3/P4 use an increment above the hardware benchmark.

esp32_gpio_touch_detach.tooltip: Detach the callback and clear pending events; touch reads remain available.

esp32_gpio_touch_wakeup.message0: Touch pin %1 deep sleep wakeup hardware threshold %2
esp32_gpio_touch_wakeup.tooltip: Configure wakeup without entering sleep. S2/S3 generally allow one touch wake channel. Combine with esp32_sleep.

esp32_gpio_adc_mv.tooltip: Returns core-calibrated millivolts. Prefer ADC1 when using Wi-Fi on ESP32.

esp32_gpio_adc_average.tooltip: Samples are clamped to 1–64. Raw range follows the ADC read resolution.

esp32_gpio_adc_resolution.tooltip: Globally affects analogRead. Extra bits may be software scaling, not increased hardware precision.

esp32_gpio_adc_attenuation.tooltip: Changes measurement range, not input voltage tolerance. Ranges vary by chip; never apply 5 V.

esp32_gpio_adc_pin_attenuation.tooltip: Changes only this ADC pin. Apply global attenuation before per-pin overrides.

esp32_gpio_dac_pin.tooltip: Maps to ESP32 GPIO25/26 or S2 GPIO17/18. S3/C3/C6 have no DAC.

esp32_gpio_dac_write.tooltip: Automatically enables true analog output; value is clamped to 0–255. No pinMode needed.

esp32_gpio_dac_voltage.tooltip: Converts 0–3.3 V using a nominal 3.3 V reference and 8-bit DAC. Supply and load affect actual voltage.

esp32_gpio_dac_disable.tooltip: Stop DAC output and release the pin.

esp32_gpio_pwm_quick.tooltip: Auto-attach at 1000 Hz / 8 bits on first use, then retain this library configuration. Duty is clamped to 0–100%.

esp32_gpio_pwm_attach.message0: Configure PWM pin %1 frequency %2 Hz resolution %3 bits
esp32_gpio_pwm_attach.tooltip: Automatically allocates an LEDC channel. ESP32 supports 1–20 bits, others usually 1–14. Reconfiguration stops previous output.

esp32_gpio_pwm_write.tooltip: Configure PWM first. Duty is clamped to 0 through 2^resolution−1.

esp32_gpio_pwm_percent.tooltip: Configure PWM first. Converts using the current resolution and clamps to 0–100%.

esp32_gpio_pwm_read.tooltip: Reads configured hardware parameters, not an external waveform.

esp32_gpio_pwm_frequency.message0: PWM pin %1 change to %2 Hz resolution %3 bits
esp32_gpio_pwm_frequency.tooltip: Reattach this pin to avoid changing a timer shared by other pins; duty resets to 0.

esp32_gpio_pwm_tone.message0: PWM pin %1 square wave %2 Hz (0 stops)
esp32_gpio_pwm_tone.tooltip: 50% duty; auto-configures 10 bits. Frequency 0 stops the waveform. Low frequencies may exceed LEDC clock limits.

esp32_gpio_pwm_fade.message0: PWM pin %1 fade from %2 %% to %3 %% over %4 ms
esp32_gpio_pwm_fade.tooltip: Configure PWM first. Hardware fade is nonblocking; do not change this pin PWM until it finishes.

esp32_gpio_pwm_invert.tooltip: Configure PWM first; useful for active-low LEDs.

esp32_gpio_pwm_detach.tooltip: Stops and releases the LEDC channel; the pin can be reconfigured or used for digital output.

esp32_gpio_pwm_ok.tooltip: Reports this library last PWM setting operation; false on invalid settings or exhausted hardware resources.

esp32_gpio_pin_mode.tooltip: Supports pulldown input and open-drain output. Open-drain HIGH releases the line and normally needs an external pull-up.

esp32_gpio_pull.tooltip: Changes pulls without changing direction. Classic ESP32 GPIO34–39 have no internal pull resistors.

esp32_gpio_drive.tooltip: Sets drive capability, not regulated current; do not directly drive motors or other heavy loads.

esp32_gpio_hold.tooltip: Latches pin configuration and level. Restore the desired mode and level before releasing to avoid glitches.

esp32_gpio_deep_hold.message0: Digital pin hold during deep sleep %1
esp32_gpio_deep_hold.tooltip: ESP32/S2/S3/C3 also need per-pin hold. C6/P4 use per-pin hold alone; this global block makes no change. Release each pin individually.

esp32_gpio_wakeup.tooltip: Configures level wakeup only. Set input mode and pulls first, then enter light sleep with esp32_sleep.

esp32_gpio_reset.tooltip: Release PWM, DAC, interrupts and hold first; restore the GPIO default configuration.

esp32_gpio_interrupt.tooltip: Set input mode first. Actions run in loop; edges may coalesce, so this is not a pulse counter. Mechanical buttons still need debouncing.

esp32_gpio_interrupt_detach.tooltip: Detach this pin interrupt and discard pending events.
